known_cpu_differences.name: equipment-display-name-does-not-collapse-quantity-components
known_cpu_differences.reason: Pinned CPU collapses distinct equipment components by display name before quantity grouping

known_health_cpu_differences.name: max-hp-expiry-clamps-to-current-maximum
known_health_cpu_differences.reason: Pinned CPU does not clamp current HP when a max_hp_pct carrier expires

known_health_cpu_differences.name: maximum-hp-expiry-can-reach-adjacent-full
known_health_cpu_differences.reason: Pinned CPU leaves stale hp_pct after max_hp_only_pct expiry and misses adjacent-full transition

known_health_cpu_differences.name: lazy-max-hp-first-consumption-and-derived-percentage
known_health_cpu_differences.reason: Pinned CPU does not resynchronize hp_pct after a lazy maximum-HP buff resolves during get_buffs; GPU synchronizes the derived percentage on the next observation.

known_health_cpu_differences.name: bullet-expiry-clamps-current-hp-to-new-maximum
known_health_cpu_differences.reason: Pinned CPU leaves current HP above the new maximum after bullet exhaustion; shared GPU preserves the existing current-HP clamp contract.

known_mode_cpu_differences.name: mode-expiry-end-child-starts-fresh-session
known_mode_cpu_differences.reason: Pinned CharState._in_weapon_change never observes the expired gap when the end callback immediately creates a child mode. GAMEPLAY.md:577-578 requires a new mode magazine and fresh charge; keep the pre-existing shared fresh-session expectation.
